decor_neon_desk_lamp.name: Neon Desk Lamp
decor_neon_desk_lamp.description: A glowing neon desk lamp that casts a soft cyan light across your room.

decor_holo_plant.name: Holo Plant
decor_holo_plant.description: A low-maintenance holographic plant. Never needs water, always in bloom.

decor_circuit_rug.name: Circuit Rug
decor_circuit_rug.description: A woven rug patterned with glowing circuit traces to tie the room together.

decor_trophy_shelf.name: Trophy Shelf
decor_trophy_shelf.description: A wall-mounted shelf to display your earned trophies and milestones.

decor_star_map_window.name: Star Map Window
decor_star_map_window.description: A window pane that renders a slowly drifting star map of the SHADDAI sky.

decor_ambient_speaker.name: Ambient Speaker Set
decor_ambient_speaker.description: A pair of ambient speakers that add a subtle synth hum to your workspace.

cosmetic_cyber_visor.name: Cyber Visor
cosmetic_cyber_visor.description: A sleek cyber visor cosmetic your agent can wear. Purely visual.

cosmetic_gold_trim.name: Gold Trim
cosmetic_gold_trim.description: Adds a polished gold trim accent to your agent’s outfit.

cosmetic_aura_glow_cyan.name: Aura Glow — Cyan
cosmetic_aura_glow_cyan.description: A cyan color-theme aura glow that surrounds your agent.

cosmetic_aura_glow_violet.name: Aura Glow — Violet
cosmetic_aura_glow_violet.description: A violet color-theme aura glow that surrounds your agent.

cosmetic_aura_glow_emerald.name: Aura Glow — Emerald
cosmetic_aura_glow_emerald.description: An emerald color-theme aura glow that surrounds your agent.

cosmetic_halo_ring.name: Halo Ring
cosmetic_halo_ring.description: A floating halo ring cosmetic that hovers above your agent.

upgrade_faster_work.name: Faster Work (+speed)
upgrade_faster_work.description: A deterministic +10% speed boost to your agent’s work throughput.

upgrade_focus_core.name: Focus Core (+Sparks yield)
upgrade_focus_core.description: A deterministic +10% Sparks yield on completed work sessions.

upgrade_extra_session_slot.name: Extra Session Slot
upgrade_extra_session_slot.description: Unlocks one additional concurrent work session slot. Permanent.

upgrade_deep_focus_core.name: Deep Focus Core (+Sparks yield II)
upgrade_deep_focus_core.description: A deterministic +25% Sparks yield on completed work sessions. Replaces Focus Core.

premium_founder_badge.name: Founder Badge
premium_founder_badge.description: A permanent Founder badge shown on your profile and agent. Cosmetic status only.

premium_legendary_room_theme.name: Legendary Room Theme
premium_legendary_room_theme.description: Unlocks the Legendary room theme: a fixed, fully-disclosed decor and lighting set.

premium_golden_agent_skin.name: Golden Agent Skin
premium_golden_agent_skin.description: A permanent golden skin cosmetic for one agent. Purely visual, no gameplay bonus.
